scripts.deploy:site: vite build && wrangler pages deploy dist --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.test:rules: npm run rules && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-auction "vitest run tests/rules"
scripts.test:coverage: npm run rules && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-auction "vitest run tests --coverage"
scripts.test:docker: docker build -t auction-vue-test . && docker run --rm auction-vue-test sh -c "npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:rules"
scripts.e2e:all: npm run rules && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-auction "node scripts/browser/run-all.mjs"
scripts.emulators:docker: docker build -t auction-vue-test . && docker run --rm -it -p 127.0.0.1:4000:4000 -p 127.0.0.1:4400:4400 -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -p 127.0.0.1:9099:9099 auction-vue-test sh -c "npm run rules && npx firebase emulators:start --only firestore,auth --project demo-auction --config firebase.docker.json"
scripts.emulators: npm run rules && firebase emulators:start --only firestore,auth --project demo-auction
